summary.oneLiner: CapitalNumbers is a ~INR105 cr (revenue from ops) Kolkata-founded, export-driven digital product engineering boutique (BSE SME, listed Jan-2025) running a high-margin (31% EBITDA incl. other income), fully debt-free, cash-rich (~INR171 cr cash+investments vs. market cap roughly equal to cash per investor remarks) model. FY26 was an explicit "investment year": organic growth stalled (~5% rev-from-ops growth) as H2 enterprise deal cycles elongated and Middle East trade-show investments failed to convert amid West Asia disruption. The bull case rests on (a) a pivot to inorganic growth — proposed INR40 cr acquisition of Epitome Cloud (Salesforce Revenue Cloud niche, US base, ~INR28-30 cr topline) funded from IPO proceeds + internal accruals, plus 2-3 more planned acquisitions; (b) AI as fastest-growing segment; and (c) FY27 guidance of "minimum 35%" revenue growth (25-30% inorganic from Epitome) with EBITDA margin recovery toward 33%. The bear case: weak organic growth (3-5% over FY24/FY25, ~5% FY26), 35% guidance overwhelmingly acquisition-led, share price below IPO, and shareholder frustration on capital allocation (cash hoard, no buyback, thin dividend).

segment_detail.title: Segment / Revenue structure
segment_detail.body:
- **By engagement:** ~91% time & material (T&M); ~9% fixed-cost (limited-time). AI projects start as fixed-cost discovery/POC then transition to T&M on production.
- **By geography (FY26):** US ~41%, Europe & UK ~31%, India ~10%, Middle East ~11%, RoW ~7%. Middle East grew strongly (one of top-5 clients now from ME, BFSI) but company is now intentionally cautious there (no team travel, no net-new push) due to West Asia disruption.
- **AI:** AI-related revenue exceeded 10% of total for first time in FY26.
- **Verticals:** heavy BFSI exposure (payment gateways, mortgage/loan disbursement platforms, insurer automation testing) but mgmt stresses it is a horizontal digital-product-engineering company, not BFSI-specialized.

order_book.title: Pipeline / Order book
order_book.body:
- No formal order book (T&M model). FY26: 9 international trade shows (London Tech Week, MWC Barcelona + others) → **500+ qualified leads**, multiple enterprise opportunities under active discussion.
- **2 Fortune 500 client wins** in FY26: (1) life sciences & healthcare — domain analytics + warehouse management; (2) chemicals & materials — enterprise automation using UiPath. (Identities confidential.)
- Enterprise deal cycle: discussion-to-close ~6-12 months; H2 saw elongated cycles, some ramp-ups slipped into FY27.
- New **demand-gen / outbound (cold-calling) team** set up with a dedicated head, targeting Europe leads; pivoting event spend from Middle East to US/UK/Europe.

guidance.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — explicit)
guidance.body:
- **FY27 (medium term = 1 year): minimum 35% revenue growth in INR terms** — described as "most pessimistic" projection, may be revised up.
  - Of which ~**25-30% from Epitome Cloud acquisition** (~INR28-30 cr topline added); organic net-new ~INR20-25 cr before ~10% natural client churn.
  - Guidance is COMBINED (organic + inorganic), not split.
- **EBITDA margin: gradual recovery toward 33%** (i.e. ~+200 bps), driven by Gurgaon operating leverage, senior-hire productivity, improved utilization, higher-value enterprise engagements. (Mgmt clarified +200 bps is on operating income basis incl. other income.)
- **3-year aspiration: INR200 cr topline** while maintaining/improving current EBITDA margin (~"double the company in three years"); potential SME→Main Board migration and mid-cap aspiration at that point.
- Dividend: FY26 interim 10% of face value + proposed final 10% = 20% total; payout policy ~20-25% of current profit going forward.

growth_optionality.title: Growth / Optionality
growth_optionality.body:
- **M&A engine:** Epitome Cloud is first of a planned series (2-3 more acquisitions over coming years). Next target profile: service company with IP, export-driven revenue, profitable+growing, with AI domain expertise — preferably vertical (fintech/healthtech). Meeting ~one company per week with advisors.
- **Epitome strategic value:** US physical base (founder in Bay Area), Salesforce Revenue Cloud / CPQ / CLM / Agiloft / Conga specialization (few competitors), access to larger enterprise clients, certified Salesforce talent.
- **AI CoE:** R&D, enterprise AI implementation, delivery methodology, internal AI adoption to improve productivity/scalability; multiple pilots → production.
- US physical office planned post-Epitome → reinvest in US/Europe events.

margins.title: Margins & cost
margins.body:
- EBITDA margin 31% (FY26) vs comparable FY25; moderation from planned investments: global S&M, Gurgaon center expansion, senior talent induction, AI capability building. Other expenses +30% YoY — driven by marketing/sales + technical/subcontractor fees (ME staff deployed via third-party provider since no ME legal entity).
- New-technology investment is **fully expensed** (not capitalized).
- Margin recovery thesis: Gurgaon operating leverage + senior-hire productivity + utilization + premium engagements (incl. Epitome's premium Salesforce rates, adjusted EBITDA in line with existing).

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- **Cash deployment:** ~INR171 cr cash+investments → primarily inorganic (Epitome INR40 cr from IPO proceeds + internal accruals, no external debt) + 2-3 further acquisitions + organic tech/talent build-out + US office.
- **No buyback** currently (multiple investors pushed for it given market cap ~= cash; mgmt "will consider" / maybe revisit after a year).
- **Dividend** ~20% of face value FY26; policy ~20-25% of profit.
- Promoter group held 74.98% (31-Mar-26); CEO raised personal stake 39.8%→40.4% via open-market buys (signal of confidence).
- Debt-free; current ratio ~29.8x.

management_tone.title: Management tone
management_tone.body: - Candid and defensive in parts; CEO repeatedly acknowledged "fair question" on growth miss, explicitly called the 35% guidance "most pessimistic." Transparent about Middle East pullback and trade-show under-spend (44 lakh in H2). CFO pushed back firmly on share-price complaints ("cannot comment... driven by investors"). Confident on M&A thesis and AI optionality; emphasizes credentials/certifications (ISO 9001/27001, SOC 2 Type 2) as moat for a small-cap. Overall: investing-for-growth narrative under visible shareholder pressure on returns.

risks.title: Risks
risks.body:
- Organic growth structurally weak (3-5% FY24/FY25, ~5% FY26 rev-from-ops); 35% FY27 guidance is acquisition-dependent (~25-30% from Epitome) — execution/integration risk on a not-yet-closed deal.
- Epitome deal still subject to definitive agreements, regulatory approvals, closing (expected 8-12 weeks); reverse risk if not consummated.
- Global macro uncertainty / elongated enterprise decision cycles; delayed ramp-ups slipping quarters.
- Middle East geopolitical (West Asia) disruption — stranded trade-show investments, paused ME expansion despite it being 11% of revenue.
- AI talent availability/scarcity.
- Share price below IPO; shareholder dissatisfaction on returns and capital allocation (idle cash).
- Client concentration / ~10% natural churn; T&M dependence (~91%).
- Valuation/optics risk: per-capita acquisition cost (~INR90 lakh/person for Epitome vs ~INR22 lakh/person own) flagged by investor.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious points
non_obvious.body:
- 35% FY27 guidance is overwhelmingly inorganic; organic alone ~INR20-25 cr net-new (~20%) before churn — the "real" organic run-rate remains low single-to-low-double digits.
- Market cap roughly equals cash+investments (investor-flagged) — a deep-value optics that mgmt is choosing to deploy into M&A rather than buyback.
- 31% headline EBITDA margin is flattered by INR10.55 cr non-operating other income; core operating margin ~24%.
- AI contracts monetize as fixed-cost discovery/POC first, then convert to T&M at production — so AI revenue lags AI pipeline.
- ME staff routed via third-party provider (no legal entity) inflates "technical fees" within other expenses.
- "Medium term" was clarified by mgmt to mean just one year (35%), not a multi-year CAGR — only the INR200 cr / 3-year aspiration is longer-dated.

challenges.title: Challenges → potential beneficiaries
challenges.body:
| Challenge raised | Potential beneficiary (✅ validated / ⭐ inferred) |
|---|---|
| Salesforce Revenue Cloud / CPQ / CLM specialization scarce | ⭐ Niche Salesforce Revenue Cloud / Conga / Agiloft consultancies (acquisition targets) |
| AI talent scarcity for delivery | ⭐ AI/ML staffing & training providers |
| Enterprise demand for AI / cloud modernization / automation | ⭐ UiPath (RPA) and GenAI tooling vendors (UiPath named as delivery stack for a Fortune 500 win) |
| Outbound demand-gen pivot | ⭐ Lead-gen / outbound sales tooling vendors |
